programs.name: Biomedical Engineering
programs.summary: Research or Professional track. Professional track: 27 credits of coursework plus a 3-credit industry project, in life sciences, math, BME core, professional development and electives.
admission: Bachelor's in engineering, physical/life sciences, computer science or math
B average in upper-level undergraduate work
Graduate GPA of 3.0 to stay in good standing

programs.name: Civil Engineering
programs.summary: 75 credits beyond the bachelor's: 54 of coursework (3+ in math/statistics, 18+ in the major area) and 15 of dissertation. Up to 30 credits transfer in with a civil or environmental M.S.
admission: M.S. in civil or environmental engineering with a 3.3 GPA (others reviewed case by case)
Three recommendation letters, a statement naming the research area, and a resume
A professor must agree to supervise the dissertation within 15 months
